summary.text: Karl B. Allen is a Democratic member of the South Carolina Senate for District 7 in Greenville County, serving since 2013.
He is an attorney and previously served in the S.C. House from 2001 to 2012.

paragraphs.text: Allen was born on October 13, 1960, in Greenville.
His official page lists a B.A. from the University of South Carolina in 1982 and a J.D. in 1986, and says he was admitted to the U.S. Supreme Court bar in 1992.
He served in the S.C. House of Representatives from 2001 to 2012 and has been in the Senate since 2013.
His committee assignments are Banking and Insurance, Corrections and Penology, Education, Finance, Labor, Commerce and Industry, Legislative Oversight, and Rules.
